_comment: OPTIONAL custom role for sg-infosec-foundry-users (team/TEAM_MODEL.md §7.1): the Azure AI User data plane WITHOUT agent authoring, so prompt/tool changes stay owner-only preventively rather than only detectively. Populate Actions/DataActions from the CURRENT provider operations before creating it: `az provider operation show --namespace Microsoft.CognitiveServices --query "resourceTypes[?name=='accounts/projects' || name=='accounts'].operations[].name"` and the Azure AI User definition (`az role definition list --name 'Azure AI User'`). Keep every read/use action; remove the agent create/update/delete data actions marked {to-confirm}. If the tenant does not permit custom roles, leave agentConsumerRoleDefinitionId empty in rbac.parameters and rely on the drift alert.
Name: InfoSec Foundry Agent Consumer
Description: Use the InfoSec Assurance agents (threads, runs, messages, files, vector-store retrieval) without creating or modifying agents, connections or deployments.
DataActions: {to-confirm: every Azure AI User data action EXCEPT agents/write and agents/delete, e.g. Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/AIServices/agents/threads/*, .../agents/runs/*, .../agents/messages/*, .../agents/files/read, .../agents/vectorStores/read, Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/OpenAI/*/read}
